project_context: Real-Estate Lead Flow Diagram Builder (Hybrid Fullstack - Laravel 11, Blade, Vanilla JS SPA)

rules: No generic sans fonts like Inter or Roboto. Manrope is mandatory.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Labels and SLA badges must be tiny, uppercase, and widely spaced.
Avoid completely white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds for the main app canvas; use the warm off-white.
Use Lime Accent purely for primary calls-to-action (e.g., 'Save Template', 'Add Step').
Powder blue is restricted to structural backgrounds (the stage lanes).

StageLane.description: The powder-blue column representing a macro lead stage.
StageLane.classes: w-[340px] flex-shrink-0 bg-[#E8F0F4] rounded-2xl flex flex-col h-full border border-[#D1E0E8]

LaneHeader.description: Sticky top of the lane. Contains Title and SLA Badge.
LaneHeader.classes: pb-3 mb-2 border-b border-[#18181B]/10 flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 bg-[#E8F0F4] z-10

SLABadge.description: Shows the time limit for the stage.
SLABadge.classes: bg-white text-[#18181B] text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider px-2 py-1 rounded-full shadow-sm

StepCard.description: Individual logic unit inside a lane.
StepCard.classes: bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(24,24,27,0.04)] border border-[#18181B]/5 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow cursor-grab group relative

BranchChip.description: Outcomes connected to a step (Positive, Negative, No-Show).
BranchChip.classes: inline-flex items-center text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-[#18181B]/10 mt-2 gap-1

AddStepButton.description: Dashed button at the bottom of the lane.
AddStepButton.classes: w-full py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-[#18181B]/20 text-[#18181B]/60 hover:bg-white hover:border-[#18181B] transition-colors text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer

StepPalette.description: Floating action bar or sidebar containing draggable generic step templates.
StepPalette.classes: bg-white border border-[#18181B]/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-lg w-64

InlineDrawer.description: Slide-over panel from the right to configure step details.
InlineDrawer.classes: fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-[400px] bg-white shadow-2xl z-50 transform transition-transform

grids.system: The main canvas is a flex container with horizontal scrolling, not a CSS grid. Lanes are set to flex-shrink-0 to allow side-by-side scrolling.

layouts.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#F5F3EF] border-r border-[#18181B]/5 flex flex-col hidden lg:flex
layouts.top_nav: h-24 px-8 flex flex-col justify-center bg-[#FBF9F6] border-b border-[#18181B]/5
layouts.builder_area: flex-1 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden p-8 flex gap-6 items-stretch

motion.interactions: Transition on transform and box-shadow for cards (duration-200 ease-out).
motion.drawer: Use standard CSS transitions `transform duration-300 ease-in-out` for the inline editor drawer.
motion.drag_drop: Use SortableJS. Add a `ghostClass` for the dragging item with opacity-50 and a lime dashed border.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on powder blue and off-white passes APCA contrast. Near-black (#18181B) is excellent.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must use `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4FF33] focus:ring-offset-2`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (webfont or SVG) for premium regular weighting. Core icons needed: whatsapp, envelope, clock, check-circle, arrows-split, x.
media.images: No stock photography required for this builder view. Rely entirely on UI typography, spacing, and iconography.

3d_libraries.usage: None required. This is a functional B2B admin layout.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: CRITICAL: Do NOT build this in React/Shadcn. The environment specifically dictates Laravel 11 + Blade + Vanilla JS SPA. Write semantic HTML/Blade templates with Tailwind classes.
Use SortableJS for drag-and-drop between columns. Bind it natively in Vanilla JS.
Preserve the strict premium color palette defined by the user: #FBF9F6 (warm off-white canvas), #18181B (near-black text), #D4FF33 (lime accents), #E8F0F4 (powder-blue lane panels).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the Step Editor Drawer or Step cards. They must be solid #FFFFFF with structural shadows.
Replace the spaghetti node-graph lines with a clean Stage-Lane (Kanban) layout. The logic naturally flows Top-to-Bottom within a lane, and Left-to-Right across lanes.
For the 'If/Branch' logic, do not draw SVG connecting curves. Instead, represent branches via 'Chips' inside the StepCard (e.g., an inline pill saying 'Negative ↳ Drop Lead').
Include a 'This drives every lead' explainer banner at the top of the canvas. Use plain language.
Add mandatory `data-testid` on all action targets, inputs, and step cards (e.g., `data-testid='add-step-btn-lead-entry'`).
Ensure the Manrope font is imported and applied to the root body wrapper.
